name: Event Flyer Maker
summary: Posters and flyers for parties, gigs and community events, for print and Instagram.

seo.title: Event Flyer Maker – Printable Flyers & Instagram Posts
seo.description: Make an event flyer with your event name, date and venue already designed in. Download a US Letter print PDF and a 1080×1350 Instagram version.
intro: Enter the event name, date and place, add a few highlights, and PiCraft designs a complete flyer ready to pin up or post.
One design, two files: a Letter-size print PDF with bleed and a 4:5 image sized for Instagram and Facebook feeds.

prompt:
Design an event flyer in portrait orientation, shown flat and front-on, filling the entire image edge to edge. It is the artwork itself, not a mockup: no wall, no hands, no drop shadow.
Style: {{style}}.
The flyer contains exactly the following text and nothing else, spelled exactly as written:
Headline, largest: "{{eventName}}"
[[Subheading: "{{tagline}}"]]
Date and time: "{{date}}"
Venue: "{{place}}"
[[Highlights as a short list:
{{details}}]]
[[Footer: "{{cta}}"]]
Strong visual hierarchy, perfectly legible from a distance. Keep all text at least 8% away from every edge. Print-quality.

outputs.label: Print PDF 8.5×11 in with 0.125 in bleed

specs.heading: Flyer and social sizes
notes: Large print files are upscaled from the generated design; bold, simple layouts print sharpest.

faq.q: Can I print flyers at home?
faq.a: Yes. Print the JPG or PDF at actual size on US Letter paper. Home printers can't print to the edge, so a thin white margin is normal.

faq.q: What's the best size for Instagram?
faq.a: 4:5 portrait (1080×1350 px) takes up the most space in the feed. PiCraft exports that size from every flyer.

faq.q: Can I add a QR code?
faq.a: No. Put your website in the call to action line, or add a QR code in any image editor afterwards.

faq.q: Will the details be spelled correctly?
faq.a: Usually, but always proofread before printing. Generate again if anything is off.

faq.q: Can I make a poster instead of a flyer?
faq.a: The design is portrait Letter size. For a larger poster, send the PDF to a shop that can enlarge it, and keep in mind that the print file is upscaled from the generated design.

faq.q: Which file should I post on Instagram?
faq.a: Use the 1080×1350 px image for the feed and the 1080×1920 px image for stories.

faq.q: How many highlights can I add?
faq.a: Up to four short lines. Put each one on a new line in the highlights box.

faq.q: Can I use it for an online event?
faq.a: Yes. Put the platform or link in the venue or call to action line, for example Zoom or your website.

faq.q: Can I add my own logo?
faq.a: No. Add it in an image editor after you download the flyer.
